basis.summary: The measured results in crucian carp come mostly from one 2024 paper (S5038) on the ΔhisJ live vaccine, plus one 2025 paper (S5288) giving protection rates; I put the supportive findings first and also reported the measured injection-site lesions, route-dependent response and the reversion concern, because they qualify the benefit, while background and other-species claims carry less weight.

statement_en: In crucian carp, vaccination against Aeromonas veronii was mostly reported to help: the live attenuated ΔhisJ strain raised immune markers and antibody levels, lowered bacterial loads in organs after challenge, and a separate study measured 70–75% protection with an inactivated vaccine. Safety was not clear-cut: the ΔhisJ strain caused no severe pathology and only a brief mild stress response in one group, but injection-site scale loss, swelling and ulceration occurred in some fish, protection varied with the vaccination route, and papers raise concern that live vaccines may revert to virulence.
statement_zh: 在鲫鱼上，维氏气单胞菌疫苗免疫总体多显示有益：减毒活疫苗ΔhisJ可提高免疫相关指标和血清抗体水平，攻毒后器官内载菌量降低；另一项研究中灭活疫苗的保护率为70%–75%。但安全性并非没有问题：ΔhisJ未引起严重病理变化，仅有一组出现短暂轻度应激，不过部分鱼注射部位出现掉鳞、肿胀甚至溃烂，不同免疫途径的攻毒反应也不一致，且有文献担心活疫苗可能毒力返强。

statement_zh: 两条研究只是描述了鲫鱼摄食量的测定方法,即通过称量干重差或投喂40分钟后吸出并烘干残饵来计算摄食量,都没有报告对鱼类福利的影响。

strength.en: All 2 claims come from one paper.
